rule: These waivers authorize procedural/manual-first representative interfaces only. They do not waive LOOK_LOCK / IMAGE_TARGET_APPROVAL / visual regression for final Tier A/S art.

waivers.name: Ballena de linfa
waivers.reason: Canon defines ecological role/name but not final anatomy or dimensions. The immediate production goal was deterministic filtration/flow interfaces, sockets, scale envelope and cold replay. Image-to-3D before art lock would convert an unapproved silhouette into accidental authority and add cleanup debt.

waivers.name: Fagocito guardián
waivers.reason: Historical capsule proxy is explicitly non-canon and final immune-cell silhouette is unapproved. Function-first construction establishes phagocytosis/pseudopod/telegraph interfaces without pretending the representative form is the final enemy design.

waivers.name: Extractor de pulso
waivers.reason: Canon does not define origin/faction/mobility/final design. A deterministic anchored siphon/pressure interface inside the existing envelope provides integration sockets without inventing visual canon. Final art must be look-locked separately.

waivers.name: Colonia parasitaria
waivers.reason: The production problem is systemic colony topology (mother/buds/feed/adhesion/dispersal interfaces), not a single hero mesh. Procedural/manual topology is cleaner and more reusable at this stage; final appearance/species identity still requires look lock.
